verdict.rationale: Publishing guidance on market-specific startup instruments is a fair question for a global law firm. The evidence shows only a US-centric glossary (409A, 83(b), SAFE) and offices in London, Hong Kong and Singapore. Nothing shows the firm publishes on UK EMI, German VSOPs, Indian FDI/ESOP rules, French BSPCE or other jurisdiction-specific instruments; office presence is adjacent, not publication.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm publishes on jurisdiction-specific startup instruments and rules of my market — e.g. UK EMI schemes, German VSOPs, Indian FDI/ESOP rules, French BSPCE
